title: Friendship with Dr. Jim Fulcher: hunting, bourbon and Ben Webster records
summary: Leeman recalls hours with Fulcher, who loved Ben Webster and owned a vast record collection, and counted Leeman among his favorite drummers.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: To bring th is discourse to an end, I spent countless hours with Jim Fulcher on Odessa. Jazz was our interest -- we had several interests, such as bird hunting we discussed that. I never got to accept his invitation to
join him. He owned bird dogs and did much dove and quail hunting.

We had a mutual agreement to stick to bourbon and I to vodka at this time, which was another one of our close interests. He had a tremendous love for Ben Webster, and he had a record collection that was unbelievable of all the greats down through the years. He was a big collector, and when he put this party together, those of us who were still living and so forth, he hired us, and I'm happy to say I was one of his favorite drummers, and when he found out how much I knew Ben Webster -- he didn't realize that. One of the things he had of Ben, I was on.
